description: Creates or updates customers' referral codes, matched by ItemId, then by customer. A code another customer uses is refused.

items.description: A customer's referral code and the referrals it earned.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

CustomerId.description: The id of the customer who shares the code. Import the customers first.

Code.description: The referral code, unique across customers.

Referrals.description: The friends who ordered with the code and the rewards the customer earned.

Profiles.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.
